observations: Single photo shows a black original-style PS4 console standing upright next to what appears to be its stand/cover, with one DualShock 4 controller resting against it.
'PS4' logo is visible embossed on the console body.
Only one controller is visible in the photo despite the seller's claim of '2 pads'.
No games, discs, cables, power brick, HDMI cable, or box of accessories are visible in the photo.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI HUMAN GADGETS HUB' overlays the image, indicating this is a reposted/stock-style listing photo rather than a live photo of the actual unit for sale.
No power-on, screen, or disc-tray shot is provided to show the console functioning.

identity.model: PS4 (original/fat model, based on body shape)

claims.evidence: No close-up of serial/label or power brick showing UK plug/voltage; cosmetic 'clean' claim not visible in a low-detail stock-style photo.
Only 1 controller is visible in photo 0.
No accessories (cables, power brick, charging dock) are visible in photo 0.
No discs, game cases, or digital library screenshot shown in photo 0.
No power-on test, boot screen, or disc-read clip provided.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have hardware faults (common PS4 issues: HDMI port, disc drive, overheating/fan noise)
risks.proof: Video clip of console powering on to home screen and reading a disc
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / for-parts condition

risks.risk: Second controller may be missing, faulty, or have stick drift
risks.proof: Photo of both controllers together, plus a clip showing both connecting and functioning
risks.if_unproven: priced as console with only 1 working pad, second pad valued at zero

risks.risk: Games claimed may not be licensed/legitimate copies or may not match 'FC24' claim
risks.proof: Photo of game library screen on console showing installed/disc titles
risks.if_unproven: priced as console only, no games included

risks.risk: No power cable/HDMI cable shown; buyer may need to source separately
risks.proof: Photo of included cables and power brick laid out next to console
risks.if_unproven: priced as console only, accessories valued at zero

risks.risk: 'UK used' claim cannot be confirmed, may affect power brick voltage/plug type
risks.proof: Close-up photo of power brick label showing input voltage and plug type
risks.if_unproven: treated as unverified origin, no premium applied

risks.risk: Photo appears to be a generic/stock promotional image (watermarked 'posted on jiji') rather than the actual unit, raising risk of bait-and-switch
risks.proof: Fresh photos of the actual unit with today's date/handwritten note, plus serial number visible
risks.if_unproven: priced conservatively assuming unverified actual condition

proof_requests: Video of the actual console powering on to the PS4 home screen and successfully reading a disc
Photo of both controllers side by side, each connected and showing battery/charge status
Photo of the game library/disc collection showing the 10 titles including FC24
Photo of included cables and power brick with a clear shot of the voltage/plug label
Close-up photo of the console's serial number sticker (usually on the underside)
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a Sony PS4 console, but the photo only confirms the bare console and one controller; all other claims (second pad, accessories, 10 games, working condition, UK origin) are unverified or contradicted, so it must be priced at worst case as a single bare console with one controller, unproven to power on.
